diagnosis_assessments.label: triage-v2-pilot-r1
diagnosis_assessments.reviewer: Codex post-run analyst in the same task; not an independent human panel
diagnosis_assessments.rationale: The original allegation and all three returned witnesses match the reference defect: MigrationGenerateCommand.ts:117-137 inserts query text into generated template literals while escaping backticks only. The interpolation example survives that operation and executes when the generated method runs. Missing schema-builder provenance and the migration caller affect exposure, not this local encoding defect. The supported/conditional disposition is justified by the staged source; no exploit execution is established.

The remaining string transformations do not restore it. Emission into the Edge manifest supports the local defect. Runtime matching and application authorization are absent, so conditional exposure is appropriate.
